definitions: To hold a grudge or resentment, often due to a past injustice or feeling of inferiority.
To be easily offended or quick to anger, often because one feels they have been wronged.
examples: He's always had a chip on his shoulder about not getting promoted.
She seems to have a chip on her shoulder regarding her upbringing.
Don't mention his old school; he has a chip on his shoulder about it.
lemma: have a chip on one's shoulder
source: have a chip on one's shoulder
